  • Class
    Description
    Anchor
    A rectangle a library names and supplies per screen, for panels to be placed around with an AnchorPanelAdapter: a slot group's box (SlotKit), the pause menu's button column, the title screen's buttons.
    AnchorPanelAdapter
    Places a Panel on Anchors: rectangles another library names and supplies per screen (a slot group's box, the pause menu's button column).
    ContainerRegion
    The container region (7.4.0): on a container screen, the player's inventory never scrolls, and everything above it is one column that scrolls together.
    ContainerRegion.Builder
    Builds one section of the container region.
    ContainerRegion.Sections<K>
    Builds one kind of section made per live key.
    ContainerRegion.Source
    Where a section's items are: the container it shows.
    ContainerTabs
    Tabs on the container screen's panels (7.4.0): a row of tabs, like the creative inventory's, on an edge of the container region's container list or inventory panel.
    ContainerTabs.Builder
    Builds one tab.
    ContainerTabs.Edge
    The panel edge a tab's row stands on.
    ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K>
    Builds a list of groups (ContainerTabs.groups(String, ModeScope, Supplier, Function)).
    ContainerTabs.GroupTab<G,K>
    What a list of groups' sub-tab is (ContainerTabs.Groups.tab): its group, its key, and the builder to set up.
    ContainerTabs.Icon
    What a tab's icon draws: the mod's own drawing, every frame, in the icon box at (x, y), width by height.
    ContainerTabs.Keyed<K>
    Builds a keyed list of tabs (ContainerTabs.keyed(String, ModeScope, Supplier)).
    Contribution
    One mod's part of a shared panel (SharedPanels, 7.4.0): its elements, its order in the panel, the mode it shows in and its own visibleWhen, plus the panel's own declaration (where it goes per mode, its style, its axis and gap, whether it is fixed, how many fit in a column per mode).
    Contribution.Builder
    Builds a Contribution.
    Focus
    Focus for widgets MenuKit places on a screen, and the "is this point covered by MenuKit" checks.
    InsideRegion
    A region on a reference rectangle: one of nine spots, the four corners, the four edge midpoints, and the center, inset from the edge.
    MKScreen
    Base class for standalone screens built with MenuKit: full-screen, client-local, interactive UIs not tied to a container menu.
    ModeScope
    Which game mode a declaration is for (7.4.0): ModeScope.SURVIVAL, ModeScope.CREATIVE or ModeScope.BOTH.
    OutsideRegion
    A region outside a reference rectangle: pick a side, pick which end to align to, and stack away from that end.
    Panel
    The basic unit of composition.
    Panel.Builder
    Builds a Panel.
    PanelPosition
    Where a panel sits: the one placement declaration every host reads.
    PanelPosition.Mode
    How a panel is positioned.
    PanelStyle
    Visual style for a panel's background.
    Placement
    Where a panel goes in one mode (7.4.0): what it is placed against, and its position there.
    Reference
    The rectangle a panel is placed against, a reference.
    RegionConstants
    The region layout constants, stacking gaps and edge insets, in one place.
    ScreenFrames
    A vanilla container screen made taller or shorter at a seam (7.4.0): its frame gains (or loses) by rows at row seam of its own layout, so screens of nearly one size can be made exactly one, and a tab row standing on their frames doesn't move as one opens in place of another.
    ScreenKind
    The look of the screen an element is on, which decides how it draws (6.1.0; renamed in 7.3.0).
    ScreenMatcher
    Which screens a registered slot (or any feature meant for every inventory screen) applies to.
    ScreenOrigin
    Screen-space top-left coordinates of a panel: what a pixel(...) placement supplies each frame, and what a panel host resolves every other placement to (RegionMath.resolveMenu / resolveInside).
    ScreenPanelAdapter
    Puts a Panel on vanilla container screens.
    SharedPanels
    Panels several mods share (7.4.0).
    SlotDecorations
    What a mod draws on a container screen's slots (7.5.0), under the item or over it, so no mod mixes into the slot's draw.
    SlotDecorations.Decoration
    What one mod draws on a slot, and the tooltip it answers there.
    SlotItemLooks
    What a slot's item draws as on a container screen (7.4.0): a mod says, per slot and per frame, which ItemAnimation the item draws with and how far through it is, and the slot draws that in place of the item.
    SlotItemLooks.Look
    What one mod draws a slot's item as.
    VanillaScreenPanelAdapter
    Puts a Panel on vanilla non-container screens: Options, Controls, KeyBinds, world select, the title screen, and any other Screen that is not a container screen.
    WrapsPanelAdapter
    Marks a class as a thin wrapper around ScreenPanelAdapter, VanillaScreenPanelAdapter or AnchorPanelAdapter, so PanelHost.captureCallerModId() walks past it to credit the mod that actually called the wrapper, not the library that wrote it.
